data.title: Bioinspired robot airdrops into remote waters via morphing wing-sail
data.description: “Fall like a maple seed, sail like a boat” sounds like advice from legendary heavyweight boxer Muhammad Ali. In reality, it describes a new robotic platform scientists have created for fast, long-term deployment to monitor remote waters.
data.keywords: ALBATROSS robot, autorotating robot, airborne robot, sailing robot, SUTD robot, water monitoring robot, nature-inspired robot, seed parachute, robot wingsail, maritime sensor platform, environmental monitoring robot, autonomous sailing robot, robot deployment aircraft, robot fall stabilization, fish-tail rudder robot
